mentions.name: Home Inspector Report Webapp
mentions.description: This webapp lets home inspectors fill out and generate inspection reports from their phones, aiming to be cheaper, faster, and easier than existing report software. It is an early-phase SaaS project with no demo yet, built with WASM and web components.
mentions.problem: Existing home inspection report software is too expensive, slow, and difficult to use.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a webapp for home inspectors. Early phases, no demo yet, just occasional updates and screenshots: https://wonger.dev/nuggets#n166

It's been tough to find work, so I figured I'd revisit an old SaaS idea. I worked for a home inspector in the past and saw a need for better (cheaper/faster/easier) report software.
